source_units.text_en: About the TOGAF® Series Guides
The TOGAF® Series Guides contain guidance on how to use the TOGAF Standard and how to adapt it to fulfill specific needs.

The TOGAF® Series Guides are expected to be the most rapidly developing part of the TOGAF® Standard and are positioned as the guidance part of the standard. While the TOGAF Fundamental Content is expected to be long-lived and stable, guidance on the use of the TOGAF Standard can be industry, architectural style, purpose, and problem-specific. For example, the stakeholders, concerns, views, and supporting models required to support the transformation of an extended enterprise may be significantly different than those used to support the transition of an in-house IT environment to the cloud; both will use the Architecture Development Method (ADM), start with an Architecture Vision, and develop a Target Architecture on the way to an Implementation and Migration Plan. The TOGAF Fundamental Content remains the essential scaffolding across industry, domain, and style.

1. Introduction

sections.translation_zh: 本文档介绍**架构能力成熟度模型**（Architecture Capability Maturity Models）的概念，以及用于评估和量化组织在**企业架构**（Enterprise Architecture）方面成熟度的技术，并给出一个可公开获取的框架作为示例。任何企业都可以使用该框架来制定适合自身组织的成熟度模型。

source_units.text_en: 1.1. Objective

This document introduces the concept of Architecture Capability Maturity Models, techniques for evaluating and quantifying an organization’s maturity in Enterprise Architecture, including a publicly available framework as an example, which can be used by any enterprise to develop their own organization-specific maturity model.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 本指南用公开框架示例帮助企业建立适合自身组织的成熟度模型。
semantic_rules.boundary_zh: 示例不是全行业统一成熟度认证要求。

evidence.quote_en: develop their own organization-specific maturity model

sections.translation_zh:
能够有效管理变革的组织，通常比做不到这一点的组织更为成功。许多组织清楚自己需要改进流程才能成功管理变革，却不知道从何入手。这类组织通常走向两个极端：要么因为不确定如何推进，在流程改进上投入极少；要么开展大量并行且缺乏聚焦的工作，投入很多却收效甚微甚至毫无成效。

**能力成熟度模型**（Capability Maturity Model, CMM）通过提供一套有效且经过验证的方法，帮助组织逐步获得对变革流程的控制并持续改进，从而解决这一问题。此类模型带来以下收益：

- 描述任何组织为改进其流程而必须执行的实践；
- 提供一把标尺，用以定期衡量改进程度；
- 构成一个经过验证的框架，用于管理改进工作；
- 将各种实践组织成分级层次，每一级代表对开发环境进行控制和管理的能力提升。

依据模型对组织实践进行评估——称为“**评估**”（assessment）——可以确定组织当前所处的级别。它既表明组织在相关领域内的执行能力，也指出组织应重点关注哪些实践，才能获得最大改进和最高投资回报。CMM 能有效引导投入方向，其收益已有充分记载。

source_units.text_en: 1.2. Background

Organizations that can manage change effectively are generally more successful than those that cannot. Many organizations know they need to improve their processes in order to successfully manage change but do not know how. Such organizations typically either spend very little on process improvement, because they are unsure how to proceed; or spend a lot, on a number of parallel and unfocused efforts, to little or no avail.

Capability Maturity Models (CMMs) address this problem by providing an effective and proven method for an organization to gradually gain control over and improve its change processes. Such models provide the following benefits:
• They describe the practices that any organization must perform in order to improve its processes
• They provide a yardstick against which to periodically measure improvement
• They constitute a proven framework within which to manage the improvement efforts
• They organize the various practices into levels, each level representing an increased ability to control and manage the development environment

An evaluation of the organization’s practices against the model – called an “assessment” – determines the level at which the organization currently stands. It indicates the organization’s ability to execute in the area concerned, and the practices on which the organization needs to focus in order to see the greatest improvement and the highest return on investment. The benefits of CMMs to effectively direct effort are well documented.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 成熟度层次反映控制与管理开发环境能力的提升，并用于定期衡量改进。

sections.translation_zh:
由卡内基梅隆大学（Carnegie Mellon University）运营的**软件工程研究所**（Software Engineering Institute, SEI）于 20 世纪 90 年代初为软件领域开发了最初的 CMM（SW-CMM），至今仍被广泛使用。该 CMM 提供了一个框架，使成熟度模型得以在众多学科中发展。

将这些技术应用于其他领域的兴趣日益增长，促成了一系列模板化工具，用于评估：

- 架构流程的状态；
- 架构描述的完整性；
- 组织对两者的认同与支持程度。

这些模型所处理的主要问题包括：

- 流程实施与审计；
- 质量度量；
- 人员能力；
- 投资管理。

它们涉及多种模型的使用，并特别关注衡量业务收益与投资回报。

一个密切相关的主题是**架构技能框架**（Architecture Skills Framework，参见《TOGAF® 系列指南：架构技能框架》[G198]）。该框架可用于规划组织成功开发与运用企业架构所需的目标技能和能力，并确定个人的培训与发展需求。

**尾注**

[1] 参见 www.sei.cmu.edu。

source_units.text_en: 1.3. History and Application

The Software Engineering Institute (SEI),[1] operated by Carnegie Mellon University, developed the original CMM (Capability Maturity Model) for Software (SWCMM) in the early 1990s, which is still widely used today. This CMM provided a framework to develop maturity models in a wide range of disciplines.
The increasing interest in applying these techniques to other fields has resulted in a series of template tools which assess:
• The state of the architecture processes
• Completeness of the architecture description
• The organization’s buy-in to both
The main issues addressed by these models include:
• Process implementation and audit
• Quality measurements
• People competencies
• Investment management
They involve use of a multiplicity of models, and focus in particular on measuring business benefits and return on investment.

A closely related topic is the Architecture Skills Framework (see the TOGAF® Series Guide: Architecture Skills Framework [G198]), which can be used to plan the target skills and capabilities required by an organization to successfully develop and utilize Enterprise Architecture, and to determine the training and development needs of individuals.
Endnotes
[1] Refer to www.sei.cmu.edu.

sections.title_zh: 2. 美国商务部 ACMM 框架

source_units.text_en: 2. US DoC ACMM Framework

sections.translation_zh:
作为将 CMM 技术应用于企业架构的一个示例：美国所有联邦机构都被期望提供成熟度模型与评级，作为其 IT 投资管理和审计要求的一部分。

美国商务部（Department of Commerce, DoC）为此专门开发了**架构能力成熟度模型**（Architecture Capability Maturity Model, ACMM），用以辅助开展内部评估。ACMM 提供了一个框架，涵盖高效企业架构流程的关键组成部分。其目标是通过识别薄弱环节、提供明确的演进路径来改进整体架构流程，从而提高企业架构成功的总体概率。

ACMM 由三部分组成：

1. 企业架构成熟度模型；
2. 不同成熟度级别下运营单元流程的企业架构特征；
3. 企业架构 CMM 评分卡。

前两部分说明架构能力的成熟度级别，以及每个成熟度级别对应的企业架构要素与特征，用作评估过程中的度量依据。第三部分用于推导架构能力成熟度级别，并报告给美国商务部首席信息官（CIO）。

source_units.text_en: 2.1. Overview

As an example of the usage in applying CMM techniques to Enterprise Architecture, all US Federal agencies are expected to provide maturity models and ratings as part of their IT investment management and audit requirements.

In particular, the US Department of Commerce (DoC) developed an Architecture Capability Maturity Model [ACMM] to aid in conducting internal assessments. The ACMM provides a framework that represents the key components of a productive Enterprise Architecture process. The goal is to enhance the overall odds for success of Enterprise Architecture by identifying weak areas and providing a defined evolutionary path to improving the overall architecture process.
The ACMM comprises three sections:
1. The Enterprise Architecture maturity model
2. Enterprise Architecture characteristics of operating units’ processes at different maturity levels
3. The Enterprise Architecture CMM scorecard

The first two sections explain the Architecture Capability maturity levels and the corresponding Enterprise Architecture element and characteristics for each maturity level to be used as measures in the assessment process. The third section is used to derive the Architecture Capability maturity level that is to be reported to the DoC Chief Information Officer (CIO).

sections.translation_zh:
美国商务部 ACMM 由**六个成熟度级别**和**九个架构要素**构成。

六个成熟度级别为：

- 0 — 无（None）
- 1 — 初始（Initial）
- 2 — 开发中（Under Development）
- 3 — 已定义（Defined）
- 4 — 已管理（Managed）
- 5 — 已度量（Measured）

九个企业架构要素为：

1. 架构流程
2. 架构开发
3. 业务关联
4. 高层管理参与
5. 运营单元参与
6. 架构沟通
7. IT 安全
8. 架构治理
9. IT 投资与采购战略

ACMM 使用两种互补的方法来计算成熟度评级。第一种方法得出加权平均的企业架构成熟度级别；第二种方法显示九个架构要素在各成熟度级别上达到的百分比。

> 计算边界：原文只说明加权平均与分级百分比两种互补方法，没有给出权重、舍入规则、缺失项处理或完整评分公式。本记录不根据等级描述自动给当前项目算分。

source_units.text_en: 2.2. Elements of the ACMM
The DoC ACMM consists of six maturity levels and nine architecture elements.
The six maturity levels are:
0 — None
1 — Initial
2 — Under development
3 — Defined
4 — Managed
5 — Measured
The nine Enterprise Architecture elements are:
1 — Architecture process
2 — Architecture development
3 — Business linkage
4 — Senior management involvement
5 — Operating unit participation
6 — Architecture communication
7 — IT security
8 — Architecture Governance
9 — IT investment and acquisition strategy

Two complementary methods are used in the ACMM to calculate a maturity rating. The first method obtains a weighted mean Enterprise Architecture maturity level. The second method shows the percentage achieved at each maturity level for the nine architecture elements.

sections.title_en: 2.3. ACMM Scoring Characteristics for Each Level of the Maturity Model
sections.title_zh: 2.3 成熟度模型各等级的 ACMM 评分特征
sections.translation_zh:
以下各节展示企业架构成熟度级别应用于九个要素时的详细特征。例如，“级别 3：已定义”的第 8 点（对多数 IT 投资实行明确的书面化治理）展示了成熟度级别 3 在要素 8（架构治理）上的状态。

#### 级别 0：无

没有开展企业架构工作（program，指组织化工作而非单份计划文档）。谈不上存在企业架构。

#### 级别 1：初始

企业架构流程非正式地运行。

1. 流程是临时性的、局部化的。定义了一些企业架构流程，但跨技术或跨业务流程没有统一的架构流程。成功取决于个人努力。
2. 企业架构流程、文档与标准通过各种临时方式建立，且局限于局部或流于非正式。
3. 与业务战略或业务驱动因素的关联极少或仅为隐含。
4. 管理团队对架构流程的了解或参与有限。
5. 运营单元对企业架构流程的接受程度有限。
6. 运营单元最新版的企业架构文档已在线发布。关于企业架构流程及可能的流程改进，几乎没有沟通。
7. IT 安全考量是临时性的、局部化的。
8. 对架构标准没有明确的治理。
9. 战略规划与采购人员极少或完全不参与企业架构流程；对现有标准的遵循极少或完全没有。

#### 级别 2：开发中

企业架构流程处于开发之中。

1. 基本的企业架构流程已有清晰文档记录。架构流程已界定明确的角色与职责。
2. 已识别 IT 愿景、原则、业务关联、基线架构与目标架构。已有架构标准，但未必与目标架构挂钩。已建立**技术参考模型**（TRM）与**标准概要**（Standards Profile）框架。
3. 与业务战略建立明确关联。
4. 管理层了解架构工作。
5. 职责已分配，工作正在推进。
6. 商务部与运营单元的企业架构网页定期更新，并用于记录架构交付物。
7. IT 安全架构已界定明确的角色与职责。
8. 对少数架构标准实施治理，并对现有标准概要有一定遵循。
9. 对 IT 投资与采购战略几乎没有或完全没有正式治理；运营单元表现出对现有标准概要的一定遵循。

#### 级别 3：已定义

已定义企业架构，包括详细的书面程序和 TRM。

1. 架构定义明确，并传达给承担运营单元 IT 职责的 IT 人员与业务管理层。流程基本得到遵循。
2. 完成差距分析与迁移计划。TRM 与标准概要充分开发。已识别 IT 目标与方法。
3. 企业架构与资本规划及投资控制相整合。
4. 高层管理团队了解并支持全企业范围的架构流程；管理层积极支持架构标准。
5. 运营单元的大多数要素接受或积极参与企业架构流程。
6. 架构文档在商务部企业架构网页上定期更新。
7. IT 安全架构标准概要已充分开发，并与企业架构整合。
8. 对多数 IT 投资实行明确的书面化治理。
9. 存在 IT 采购战略，并包含针对 IT 企业架构的合规措施；在确定项目时考虑成本效益。

#### 级别 4：已管理

企业架构流程得到管理与度量。

1. 企业架构流程已成为文化的一部分。采集与架构流程相关的质量度量。
2. 企业架构文档按固定周期更新，以反映更新后的企业架构；业务架构、数据架构、应用架构与技术架构由相应的正式制定的标准（de jure）与事实标准（de facto）界定。
3. 资本规划与投资控制根据更新后的企业架构所收到的反馈与经验教训进行调整；定期重新审视业务驱动因素。
4. 高层管理团队直接参与架构评审流程。
5. 整个运营单元接受并积极参与企业架构流程。
6. 架构文档定期更新，并经常针对最新架构发展/标准进行评审。
7. 采集与 IT 安全架构相关的绩效度量。
8. 对所有 IT 投资实行明确治理；管理偏差的正式流程将结果反馈到企业架构中。
9. 所有计划中的 IT 采购与购买均受企业架构的指导与治理。

#### 级别 5：已度量

企业架构流程持续改进。

1. 协同努力优化并持续改进架构流程。
2. 采用标准与豁免（waivers）流程来改进架构开发流程。
3. 利用架构流程度量来优化并推动业务关联；业务方参与企业架构的持续流程改进。
4. 高层管理参与优化架构开发与治理中的流程改进。
5. 来自运营单元各要素的架构流程反馈被用于推动架构流程改进。
6. 组织中的每一位决策者在每一项与 IT 相关的业务决策中都会使用架构文档。
7. IT 安全架构度量的反馈被用于推动架构流程改进。
8. 对所有 IT 投资实行明确治理；采用标准与豁免流程来改进治理流程。
9. 不存在计划外的 IT 投资或采购活动。

> 评分语境：以上是美国商务部 ACMM 示例框架的等级特征，不是当前组织的完成事实。等级 0 只有整体描述，没有原文逐要素评分条目；等级 1–5 各有九项。第 4 级已有“管理与度量”，第 5 级名称仍按原文保留为“已度量”，其内容强调反馈驱动的持续改进。不得将其改为其他模型的等级名称。

source_units.text_en: 2.3. ACMM Scoring Characteristics for Each Level of the
Maturity Model

The following sections show the detailed characteristics of the Enterprise Architecture maturity levels as applied to each of the nine elements of the maturity model. For example, Level 3: Defined, point number 8 (Explicit documented governance of majority of IT investments) shows Maturity Level 3’s state for Element 8 (Architecture Governance).
Level 0: None
No Enterprise Architecture program. No Enterprise Architecture to speak of.
Level 1: Initial
Informal Enterprise Architecture process underway.
1. Processes are ad hoc and localized
Some Enterprise Architecture processes are defined. There is no unified architecture process across technologies or business processes. Success depends on individual efforts.
2. Enterprise Architecture processes, documentation, and standards are established by a variety of ad hoc means and are localized or informal
3. Minimal, or implicit linkage to business strategies or business drivers
4. Limited management team awareness or involvement in the architecture process
5. Limited operating unit acceptance of the Enterprise Architecture process
6. The latest version of the operating unit’s Enterprise Architecture documentation is online
Little communication exists about the Enterprise Architecture process and possible process improvements.
7. IT security considerations are ad hoc and localized
8. No explicit governance of architectural standards
9. Little or no involvement of strategic planning and acquisition personnel in the Enterprise Architecture process
Little or no adherence to existing standards.
Level 2: Under Development
Enterprise Architecture process is under development.
1. The Basic Enterprise Architecture process is clearly documented
The architecture process has developed clear roles and responsibilities.
2. IT vision, principles, business linkages, Baseline, and Target Architecture are identified
Architecture standards exist, but not necessarily linked to Target Architecture. Technical Reference Model (TRM) and Standards Profile framework established.
3. Explicit linkage to business strategies
4. Management awareness of architecture effort
5. Responsibilities are assigned and work is underway
6. The DoC and operating unit Enterprise Architecture web pages are updated periodically and are used to document architecture deliverables
7. IT Security Architecture has defined clear roles and responsibilities
8. Governance of a few architectural standards and some adherence to existing Standards Profile
9. Little or no formal governance of IT investment and acquisition strategy Operating unit demonstrates some adherence to existing Standards Profile
Level 3: Defined
Defined Enterprise Architecture including detailed written procedures and TRM.
1. The architecture is well defined and communicated to IT staff and business management with operating unit IT responsibilities
The process is largely followed.
2. Gap analysis and Migration Plan are completed
Fully developed TRM and Standards Profile. IT goals and methods are identified.
3. Enterprise Architecture is integrated with capital planning and investment control
4. Senior management team aware of and supportive of the enterprise-wide architecture process
Management actively supports architectural standards.
5. Most elements of operating unit show acceptance of or are actively participating in the Enterprise Architecture process
6. Architecture documents updated regularly on the DoC Enterprise Architecture web page
7. IT Security Architecture Standards Profile is fully developed and is integrated with Enterprise Architecture
8. Explicit documented governance of majority of IT investments
9. IT acquisition strategy exists and includes compliance measures to IT Enterprise Architecture
Cost benefits are considered in identifying projects.
Level 4: Managed
Managed and measured Enterprise Architecture process.
1. Enterprise Architecture process is part of the culture
Quality metrics associated with the architecture process are captured.

2. Enterprise Architecture documentation is updated on a regular cycle to reflect the updated Enterprise Architecture. Business, Data, Application, and Technology Architectures defined by appropriate de jure and de facto standards
3. Capital planning and investment control are adjusted based on the feedback received and lessons learned from updated Enterprise Architecture
Periodic re-examination of business drivers.
4. Senior management team directly involved in the architecture review process
5. The entire operating unit accepts and actively participates in the Enterprise Architecture process
6. Architecture documents are updated regularly, and frequently reviewed for the latest architecture developments/standards
7. Performance metrics associated with IT Security Architecture are captured
8. Explicit governance of all IT investments
Formal processes for managing variances feed back into Enterprise Architecture.
9. All planned IT acquisitions and purchases are guided and governed by the Enterprise Architecture
Level 5: Measured
Continuous improvement of Enterprise Architecture process.
1. Concerted efforts to optimize and continuously improve architecture process
2. A standards and waivers process is used to improve architecture development process
3. Architecture process metrics are used to optimize and drive business linkages
Business involved in the continuous process improvements of Enterprise Architecture.
4. Senior management involvement in optimizing process improvements in architecture development and governance
5. Feedback on architecture process from all operating unit elements is used to drive architecture process improvements
6. Architecture documents are used by every decision-maker in the organization for every IT-related business decision
7. Feedback from IT Security Architecture metrics are used to drive architecture process improvements
8. Explicit governance of all IT investments
A standards and waivers process is used to make governance-process improvements.
9. No unplanned IT investment or acquisition activity

CMMI 是一套经过验证的全球最佳实践，通过构建关键能力并对其进行基准比较来驱动业务绩效。

source_units.text_en: 3.1.1. Introduction
The CMMI is a proven set of global best practices that drives business performance through building and benchmarking key capabilities.

Originally created for the US Department of Defense to assess the quality and capability of their software contractors, CMMI models have expanded beyond software engineering to help any organization in any industry to build, improve, and measure their capabilities and improve performance. For over 30 years, high-performing organizations around the world have achieved demonstrable, sustainable business results with the CMMI. CMMI is now administered by the CMMI Institute[1], which is managed by ISACA.

CMMI best practices focus on what needs to be done to improve performance and align operations to business goals. Designed to be understandable, accessible, flexible, and integrate with other methodologies such as Agile, CMMI models help organizations to understand their current level of capability and performance and offer a guide to optimize business results.
The CMMI Institute helps enterprises to meet the challenges of the changing global business landscape.

sections.translation_zh:
CMMI Institute 的模型有助于识别并改进那些能够提升组织绩效、质量与盈利能力的关键能力。在业务中，问题或解决方案往往并不显而易见。借助经过验证的最佳实践，CMMI Institute 的模型可以让你看清组织现有流程的水平，以及哪些地方需要改进绩效。

使用这些模型与视图能够降低风险、返工、缺陷、交付错误与成本，同时提升客户满意度、生产率、决策能力、质量与竞争优势。

CMMI 系列资源分为**视图**（views，依据 TOGAF 标准 [C220] 与 ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 [ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010]）与**模型**（models），两者都是最佳实践与关键能力的集合。

CMMI 视图如下：

- **CMMI V2.0 模型——开发视图**（Development View）：一套集成的最佳实践，提升组织开发满足客户与最终用户需求的高质量产品和服务的能力。  
  主要收益：提升质量、降低成本、缩短上市时间、改进产品生命周期管理、获得组织敏捷性。
- **CMMI V2.0 模型——服务视图**（Services View）：一套集成的最佳实践，提升组织高效、有效地交付满足市场与客户需求的高质量服务的能力。  
  主要收益：赢得客户忠诚、增强韧性、缩短上市时间、提升质量、降低成本。
- **CMMI V2.0 模型——供应商管理视图**（Supplier Management View）：一套集成的最佳实践，提升组织以最大化供应链效率并降低风险的方式识别和管理供应商与厂商的能力。  
  主要收益：满足增长需求、跟上产品需求、降低供应链风险。

CMMI 模型如下：

- **人员能力成熟度模型**（People Capability Maturity Model, People CMM）：为提升组织劳动力能力提供指导。这些最佳实践有助于识别技能差距、打破工作流瓶颈，并赋能团队成员发展有助于组织成功的技能。  
  关键过程域：沟通与协调、授权工作组、薪酬、持续劳动力创新与规划、胜任力与职业发展。
- **数据管理成熟度模型**（Data Management Maturity, DMM）：为提升组织全企业范围的能力提供指导，帮助制定数据管理改进的定制路线图。DMM 提供实施数据战略、治理、质量、运营与架构的最佳实践。  
  关键过程域：数据管理战略、数据治理、数据质量、数据运营、数据架构。

据 SEI 所述，CMMI 模型在许多重要方面改进了以往模型的最佳实践，特别是使组织能够：

- 更明确地将管理与工程活动同业务目标关联；
- 扩展产品生命周期与工程活动的范围与可见性，确保产品或服务满足客户期望；
- 吸收来自更多最佳实践领域（如度量、风险管理、供应商管理）的经验教训；
- 实施更稳健的高成熟度实践；
- 应对对其产品与服务至关重要的更多组织职能；
- 更充分地符合相关 ISO 标准。

CMMI 已在全球范围内被采用。

> 版本与范围：本节保留源文所列 CMMI V2.0 视图、People CMM 和 DMM；不声称这些就是当前最新版本，也不把此处模型条目与前文 ACMM 六个等级直接对齐。采用模型的预期收益需要组织实际实施和评估证据。

source_units.text_en: 3.1.2. CMMI Views and Models

CMMI Institute models help to identify and improve the key capabilities that elevate your organization’s performance, quality, and profitability. Many times, in business, the problem or solution is not obvious. With proven best practices, CMMI Institute models allow you to see how your organization’s existing processes measure up and where performance improvements are needed.

Use of the models and views results in reduced risk, rework, defects, delivery errors, and cost. It also results in increased customer satisfaction, productivity, decision-making ability, quality, and competitive advantage.

The CMMI family of resources is broken into views (as per the TOGAF Standard [C220] and ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 [ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010]) and models, both of which are sets of best practices and key capabilities.
The CMMI views are as follows:

• The CMMI V2.0 Model – Development View is an integrated set of best practices that improves an organization’s capability to develop quality products and services that meet the needs of customers and end users
Key benefits are Increase Quality, Reduce Cost, Improve Time-to-Market, Improve Product Lifecycle Management, and Gain Organizational Agility.

• The CMMI V2.0 Model – Services View is an integrated set of best practices that improves an organization’s capability to efficiently and effectively deliver quality service offerings that meet market and customer needs
Key benefits are Gain Customer Loyalty, Develop Resiliency, Improve Time-to-Market, Increase Quality, and Reduce Cost.

• The CMMI V2.0 Model – Supplier Management View is an integrated set of best practices that improves an organization’s capability to identify and manage suppliers and vendors in a way that maximizes supply chain efficiency and reduces risk
Key benefits are Meet Growth Demands, Keep Pace with Product Demands, and Reduce Supply Chain Risk.
The CMMI models are as follows:
• The People Capability Maturity Model (People CMM) provides guidance for improving the capability of an organization’s workforce
These best practices help to identify skill gaps to break down workflow bottlenecks and empower team members to develop skills that will help the organization succeed.
Key process areas are Communication & Coordination, Empowered Workgroups, Compensation, Continuous Workforce Innovation & Planning, Competency & Career Development.
• The Data Management Maturity (DMM) model provides guidance for improving your organization’s capability across the enterprise to build a customized roadmap for data management improvement
The DMM provides best practices for implementing data strategy, governance, quality, operations, and architecture.
Key process areas are Data Management Strategy, Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Operations, and Data Architecture.
According to the SEI, the use of the CMMI models improves on the best practices of previous models in many important ways, in particular enabling organizations to:
• More explicitly link management and engineering activities to business objectives
• Expand the scope of and visibility into the product lifecycle and engineering activities to ensure that the product or service meets customer expectations
• Incorporate lessons learned from additional areas of best practice (e.g., measurement, risk management, and supplier management)
• Implement more robust high-maturity practices
• Address additional organizational functions critical to its products and services
• More fully comply with relevant ISO standards
CMMI has been adopted worldwide.

source_units.text_en: 3.1.3. SCAMPI® Method

The Standard CMMI Appraisal Method for Process Improvement [SCAMPI] is the appraisal method associated with CMMI. The SCAMPI appraisal method is used to identify strengths, weaknesses, and ratings relative to CMMI reference models. It incorporates best practices found successful in the appraisal community, and is based on the features of several legacy appraisal methods. It is applicable to a wide range of appraisal usage modes, including both internal process improvement and external capability determinations.
The SCAMPI method definition document[2] describes the requirements, activities, and practices associated with each of the processes that compose the SCAMPI method.
